meta.name: ATELIER MARIS | Casa Lumen
meta.description: Casa Lumen, a private house above the water at Begur on the Costa Brava, presented as one continuous sequence from the coastal approach through threshold, material, bathing court and horizon.

media.alt: Modern residence on a rocky Mediterranean coastline

copy.headline: A house set into a forty-metre fall to the sea.
copy.body: Casa Lumen. Two stone planes held apart by a shaded court, on a cliff plot south-east of Begur.

media.alt: Live light field for the position chapter

images.alt: Material samples on a studio table

copy.headline: The plot falls forty metres. The house does not.
copy.body: Rather than terrace the slope, two level planes are set into it and the ground passes beneath. Section first, finishes last.

media.alt: Sunlit modern atrium facing the sea

copy.headline: Nine metres of stone. Then the whole sea.
copy.body: The approach narrows to 1.9 metres between a stone wall and an oak screen, holds that width for nine metres, and releases at the living level in one move.

media.alt: Architectural material samples, sketches and tactile finishes on a studio table

copy.headline: Three materials, and glass.
copy.body: Travertine honed rather than polished, so it holds light instead of returning it. Oak quarter-sawn for straight grain. Linen undyed.

media.alt: Warm travertine wellness interior with restrained fixtures

copy.headline: A court for water, cut from the house.
copy.body: Six by four metres, a metre deep, open to the south-west. The same travertine as the floors inside, so the court reads as a room without a roof.

media.alt: Coastal architecture set against sea and rock

copy.headline: The pool edge sits on the sea line.
copy.body: Set from the principal seated position, the pool edge aligns with the coast so foreground water joins the sea.

media.alt: Coastal residence at golden hour overlooking the sea

copy.headline: We take four projects a year.
copy.body: Private houses, interior transformations and coastal retreats, run from the first survey to the last site visit by the people who drew them. Enquiries for 2026 are open.

hotspots.label: Honed travertine
hotspots.description: Open-pore travertine is honed to hold diffuse light and preserve tactile depth rather than mirror it.

hotspots.label: Oak brise-soleil
hotspots.description: Vertical oak fins reduce low western glare while keeping the sea visible in motion between the blades.

hotspots.label: Water datum
hotspots.description: The pool edge is aligned with the sea horizon from the principal living position so foreground water visually joins the coast.

conversion.title: Tell us about the plot.
conversion.body: We take four projects a year and run each one from the first survey to the last site visit. A first conversation is usually an hour, on site if the plot exists and over a table if it does not.
conversion.consent: I am happy for Atelier Maris to hold these details and reply to my enquiry. We never share them, and you can ask us to delete them at any time.
